name: PDFShift Free
free_limit: 50 HTML-to-PDF conversion credits per month; each 5 MB of generated PDF counts as one credit. Free plan allows PDFs up to 15 MB and a 30-second timeout.
watch_out: Large PDFs consume multiple credits (for example, 14 MB uses 3). Free tier has no paid overage; paid-only features include AWS S3 delivery and parallel/asynchronous responses. Credit-card and commercial-use requirements need confirmation.
